have heq (v : Track) : stock (Y a a (axes v))=(1/2:ℂ)*((W v + W (-v))-(1/2:ℂ)*V v) := by
    have hc := active (F:=U) hp he T hk hC hΩ hm a a (fun i u q hh=> signing_here (Q.tags i) (X.decor i) (X.mat i) hu h (X.health i) hd (X.guards i) hS (X.event i) (X.shades i) _ T (X.sworn i) (T.metric.rights _ _ hk hΩ.le) u q hh a a hC) (axes v) (axes_real v)
    unfold V W B x M; simp only [axes_flip]; exact hc

proof_context.conclusion: `heq`: the tested diagonal entry equals 1/2 (W(v)+W(-v) - 1/2 V(v)) with W = sum x_j M_j and V = sum x(-v)_a x(v)_j B_aj.

lemma signing_here (B T : Bed) (he : Inputs S X (B.metric.acts f) (T.metric.acts c)) (hw : T.metric.safe)
    (p : Site c) (q : Momentum) (hs : rolls (mon p) q) (i j : Loc G 1) {η : ℝ} (hM : Screened (changeCue M S.kernel.penalty N) η C) :
    let U := carrierY M S.kernel.penalty N
    let x := taxTone G T (-q) i
    let y := taxTone G T q j
    shop c (changeCue M S.kernel.penalty N i j q)= (1/2:ℂ)*(
      ((∑ a,y a * shop c (hatchTrace U (.inl i) (.inr a) q)) + (∑ a,x a * shop c (hatchTrace U (.inl j) (.inr a) (-q)))) -
         (1/2:ℂ)* ∑ a,x a*∑ b,y b*shop c (hatchTrace (U.pay U) (.inr a) (.inr b) q)) := by

proof_context.conclusion: The finite-volume form of the same identity for `changeCue` in terms of `taxTone` and the `hatchTrace` of `carrierY` and its pay.
